acceptance: Mutations publish as batches with a fixed epoch, a sequence rising by one and a whole-tree digest; a lost batch is replayed from a ring or answered by one full resync in a new epoch; a subtree resync rebuilds one node; consumers apply batches atomically.

positive.fixture: 18 browser and 8 unit tests: small changes touch only the change and the replica equals an independent capture after every scenario

negative.fixture: dropped batches, exhausted ring, corrupted digest, moved, recreated and reordered nodes, changes inside shadow roots and frames, stopped sessions

security_and_source_permissions: The observer reads structure and declared labels only; form values are never read, credential regions yield no text, account text is flagged and withheld from shared evidence, and no network surface exists.
performance_memory_storage: Steady-state flush p50 0.30 ms and p95 0.60 ms on 10007 nodes.
known_limitations: Stylesheet-only visibility changes are noticed at the next probe or related mutation
